name: ClearPost – AI Content Generator & SEO Agent
author: purposego

sections.description:
Your AI content growth engine, right inside WordPress. ClearPost is your automated organic growth engine: AI that researches and writes posts for you while you sleep, so you get found on Google and recommended by ChatGPT.

The Problem

Too much time and money spent on SEO, with too little traffic to show for it:

  • Research, design, and SEO tools eat up $500+ of budget
  • You keep bouncing between AI tools, SEO tools, and WordPress, wasting precious time context-switching and copy-pasting
  • Drafts pile up in your editor and never get finished or published
  • You spend too much time learning SEO instead of growing your business
  • Or you spend thousands on agencies or freelancers only to get minimal results

The Solution

ClearPost replaces expensive agencies and tools with a single, end-to-end workflow:

  • Gathers context automatically to deeply understand your site, content, and audience
  • Builds a totally custom SEO plan designed to drive real traffic
  • Creates posts you would actually be happy to publish, lined up in WordPress
  • Sit back while your posts rank and you cruise past your competition

Free forever. All core features are free with your own AI provider API keys. Generate posts with no limits, with full prompt history saved, and chat with AI to edit your posts faster than ever. An optional premium add-on gives you access to our SEO Agent that indexes your site to ensure new posts fit your established style effortlessly, and autonomously orchestrates SEO research and content creation.

Free Version Features (Free Forever)

  • Generate draft posts in one click – use OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini with your own API key
  • AI-Powered Editing – start “vibe-editing”: ask the built-in AI editor to change any post just by chatting with it
  • 150+ Languages – generate high-quality content in any language your audience speaks
  • Generate directly as Gutenberg blocks – no copy-paste needed, posts look great immediately
  • Support for all top AI models – choose from OpenAI’s GPTs, Anthropic’s Claude, or Google’s Gemini models
  • Zero learning curve – lives inside WordPress with no new dashboards or extra logins
  • Prompt history – recycle and refine winning prompts fast
  • Choose your post type – generate posts of any kind, even custom post types
  • Always in control – new posts generate in draft mode, you approve every post before it goes live
  • Embed a link in each post – the AI can put links in ACF fields too, perfect for directories

Premium Version Features (7-Day Free Trial)

Put AI to work while you sleep. Go further, faster with our SEO Agent. Try it free for 7 days — no credit card required.

  • New! Dashboard Command Center – see your content engine status, posts generated, and autopilot controls at a glance
  • New! 30-Day SEO Content Calendar – view, edit, and manage your automated content schedule with a visual calendar
  • New! Automated SEO Research – AI analyzes your site and competitors to create a keyword-driven content strategy
  • An SEO expert lives inside your site – gathers context automatically to deeply understand your site, content, and audience, then builds a custom SEO content plan designed to outrank your competition
  • A full AI content team writes for you – research, writing, formatting, images, links, categories, tags — all handled automatically
  • Autopilot publishing – set your posts per week, choose to review before publish, and let ClearPost handle the rest
  • Your style, reproduced effortlessly – the agent creates custom AI instructions based on your site’s existing content, so new posts automatically match your established style
  • Unlimited SEO Agent – use the SEO Agent as much as you need to build your perfect growth strategy
  • Maintain control – you can edit the AI-created system prompts for fine-grained control over how new posts come out
  • Predictable pricing – simple monthly subscription with no nasty surprises from usage-based AI provider invoices
  • 24/7 Expert Support – get help directly from the founder. Real humans, real answers, anytime

ClearPost will always be free to use. Our premium cloud service gives users access to advanced features that require intensive processing on our servers. Start your 7-day free trial today — no credit card required.

How It Works

Free Version:

  1. Setup: Enter your OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key, choose your AI model, choose your post type, and write a prompt for the post you want to create.

  2. Generate: Click “Generate Post” to create a draft post with Gutenberg blocks and optional links.

  3. Review and Edit with AI: Ask your AI copilot to make an edit and watch it edit your post in real time.

  4. Publish when you’re ready: You remain in full control of the Publish button.

  5. Click to Reuse a Prompt: Did that prompt work well? Browse your prompt history and click to use it again.

Premium Version (7-Day Free Trial):

  1. Start Your Trial: Click “Start Free Trial” — no credit card required. ClearPost immediately analyzes your site.

  2. Watch the Magic: Your Dashboard shows ClearPost researching SEO keywords and building your 30-day content calendar.

  3. Review Your Calendar: See your month of content laid out visually. Edit topics, adjust dates, or let it run on autopilot.

  4. Set Autopilot Preferences: Choose how many posts per week and whether to review before publish.

  5. Relax: ClearPost generates and schedules posts automatically. You just review and publish when ready.

Here’s what ClearPost does for you, while you sleep

Your Dashboard shows everything at a glance. See your content engine status, posts generated, scheduled content, and autopilot controls — all in one place.

An SEO expert lives inside your site. Gathers context automatically to deeply understand your site, content, and audience. Then builds a custom content plan designed to outrank your competition.

A full AI content team writes for you. Research, writing, formatting, images, links, categories, tags — all handled automatically. Just hit publish and watch the traffic roll in.

Your 30-day content calendar stays full, automatically. The SEO Agent plans your entire month of content, keeps your posting schedule full, and pings you when each draft is ready. Relax while your business grows itself.

Ready to grow on autopilot?

Picture your analytics one month from now:

  • A fresh article goes live every single day
  • Search impressions climb, clicks follow, conversions roll in
  • Competitors wonder how you suddenly outpace their content teams

With ClearPost, that future starts now. Start your 7-day free trial, cancel anytime.

Third Party Services

This plugin connects to the following third party services to provide AI content generation functionality:

AI Provider APIs (At Least One of These is Required to Use the Free Version)

The plugin connects to AI provider APIs to generate content. To use the free version, you must provide your own API key for at least one of these and agree to the respective service’s terms:

  • OpenAI – Used for GPT model content generation

    • Service: https://openai.com/
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy/
    • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/terms/

  • Anthropic – Used for Claude model content generation

    • Service: https://www.anthropic.com/
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/terms

  • Google AI (Gemini) – Used for Gemini model content generation

    • Service: https://ai.google.dev/
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms

Premium Add-On Service (Fully Optional)

  • ClearPost Premium – Our premium service provides an AI content analysis agent and directly manages AI provider API access
    • Service: https://saiap.gopurposego.com
    • When enabled, your site’s content is indexed on our server and analyzed by our Content Analysis AI Agent to automatically specify your writing style and content strategy, so future posts are generated in exactly your style without tedious manual prompt engineering
    • Premium users’ content generation requests are processed through our servers to enable full management of AI model usage with increased context
    • Premium users can edit all context provided to the AI providers and can request removal of their data from our server at any time
    • Privacy Policy: https://gopurposego.com/saiap-privacy/
    • Terms of Service: https://gopurposego.com/saiap-terms/

User Analytics (Optional)

  • ClearPost Analytics – Optional usage analytics to help improve the plugin
    • Used to understand how the plugin is being used and identify areas for improvement
    • Collects anonymous usage data such as: plugin activation, content generation events, error occurrences, and feature usage
    • No personal information, site content, or API keys are transmitted
    • Can be disabled at any time in plugin settings
    • Data is processed by our analytics service to improve plugin functionality and user experience
    • Privacy Policy: https://gopurposego.com/saiap-privacy/
    • Terms of Service: https://gopurposego.com/saiap-terms/

Data Usage

  • Free Core Plugin: Your prompts and generated content are sent directly to your chosen AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google). No data is sent to our servers unless analytics is enabled.
  • Premium Add-On: Your existing post content is indexed on our server and analyzed by our Content Analysis AI Agent, and your content generation requests are processed through our premium service to provide enhanced features.
  • Analytics (if enabled): Anonymous usage statistics are collected to improve the plugin. No personal data, content, or API keys are transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clearpost-simple-ai-auto-post folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the ‘ClearPost AI’ Settings page to configure your AI provider API keys and other options
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the core functionality is forever free to use with your own AI provider API keys. The optional premium add-on offers the SEO Agent, content analysis, site context architecture, and scheduling features that require intensive processing on our servers. Try premium free for 7 days, cancel anytime.

Do I need an API key to use this plugin?

The free version requires you to obtain an API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google. Premium users do not need to input their own AI provider API keys.

Can I customize the generated content?

Yes, you can customize the prompt used for content generation in the plugin settings. Premium users get AI-generated system prompts that automatically match your site’s style.

Does this plugin support custom post types?

Yes, you can select any public post type as the target for generated content, whatever your custom theme or setup uses.

Does this plugin allow me to embed links in the generated content?

Yes, you can embed URL links in the generated content by selecting an ACF field or other link field. The AI will automatically add the link to the selected field – perfect for directory listings or product reviews.

Is this plugin suitable for directory sites?

Yes, ClearPost works exceptionally well for directory sites. It can quickly create directory posts with embedded links, making it ideal for creating great directory content.

How does this plugin help with SEO?

ClearPost builds a totally custom SEO content plan designed to drive real traffic. By making it easy to create great content targeting specific, niche, long-tail keywords, ClearPost helps you reach searchers looking for exactly what you offer.

What’s the difference between this and other AI content generators?

ClearPost is your complete AI content growth engine. Instead of bouncing between AI tools, SEO tools, and WordPress, you get a single end-to-end workflow that gathers context, builds your SEO strategy, and creates posts you’d actually be happy to publish — all inside WordPress with zero learning curve.

What additional features do I get with the Premium version?

The Premium version puts AI to work while you sleep. Start with a 7-day free trial — no credit card required:

  • Dashboard Command Center – see your content engine status, metrics, and autopilot controls at a glance
  • 30-Day SEO Content Calendar – view, edit, and manage your automated content schedule visually
  • Automated SEO Research – AI analyzes your site and creates a keyword-driven content strategy
  • An SEO expert lives inside your site – gathers context automatically and builds a custom SEO content plan designed to outrank your competition
  • A full AI content team writes for you – research, writing, formatting, images, links, categories, tags — all handled automatically
  • Autopilot publishing – set posts per week and review-before-publish preferences
  • Your style, reproduced effortlessly – the agent creates custom AI instructions so new posts automatically match your established style
  • Unlimited SEO Agent – use it as much as you need to build your perfect growth strategy
  • 24/7 Expert Support – get help directly from the founder, real humans, real answers, anytime

Learn more and start your free trial →

How does the Premium version’s content analysis work?

The SEO Agent scans and indexes your existing posts to deeply understand your unique voice, formatting patterns, style, and topics. It then creates custom AI instructions so new posts automatically match your established style, saving you from prompt engineering for every post.
sections.changelog:
2.0.2

  • Fixed: Plugin now properly cleans up all options and transients on uninstall, preventing stale data from persisting after reinstall.

2.0.1

  • Improved wizard prefill: AI now analyzes full page and post content instead of short excerpts.
  • Homepage content is now explicitly fetched for better site understanding.
  • Competitor URL discovery: AI uses web search to find real competitors in your niche during onboarding.
  • Better onboarding experience with more accurate prefilled wizard fields.
  • Fixed: “Generate Now” success banner now shows correct button text for published vs. draft posts.

2.0.0

  • Major release! Complete UI overhaul with new Dashboard experience.
  • 30-day SEO Content Calendar: View, edit, and manage your automated content schedule.
  • Automated SEO Research: AI analyzes your site and creates a keyword-driven content strategy.
  • New Dashboard: See your content engine status, metrics, and autopilot controls at a glance.
  • Onboarding Wizard: Guided setup for new sites to get started quickly.
  • 7-day Free Trial: Try all premium features with no credit card required.
  • WordPress Dashboard Widget: Quick status overview on your main admin screen.
  • Global Admin Banners: Stay informed about your ClearPost status across WordPress.
  • Improved autopilot settings: Control posts per week and review-before-publish options.
  • Better site context analysis for more relevant content generation.

1.2.23

  • Small bugfixes and performance improvements.

1.2.22

  • Big update! Post maps, inline images, new models, formatting improvements, and more.
  • Post map formulas: Add, edit, and reuse post maps to guide the AI to create posts in your specific format.
  • Drop in a link to the post you want to mimic, and the AI will create an editable post map structure.
  • Inline image placement: Automatically add on-brand inline images into the right sections of each post.
  • Images are fetched from Google Images and inserted in the background after generation.
  • New models: Gemini 3, GPT 5.1, Claude Sonnet and Opus 4.5 now available.
  • Better SEO Strategy and Keywords with refined target keywords you can edit.
  • Models are now enabled to search the internet for sources and link them.
  • Tables are now supported inside posts for easier data visualization.
  • Added markdown support in the AI post editor chat, including links.
  • Fixed a formatting issue in newly generated posts.

1.0

  • Initial release
